description: This source file provides utilities for health checking a Kubernetes environment, including functions to fetch kubeconfig from Vault, initialize Kubernetes clients, list nodes and pods, perform system metrics collection inside containers, check TCP connectivity, assemble overall health reports, and send metrics to Kafka or Loki. It integrates with various APIs and performs log parsing and external service interactions, focusing on monitoring and diagnostics in a containerized infrastructure.
